integrity: One exact finite-time projected fourth-cumulant theorem, sharp positive reset-rate cancellation, and an independently implemented finite Fourier-moment verification program; numerical checks are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Passive planar translational Brownian motion, independent rotational diffusion and fixed-direction Poisson angle-only resets; finite-time exactness requires stationary initial orientation, deterministic starts give only asymptotic rate. Fourth cumulants are not raw moments or normalized excess kurtosis. No independent publication priority audit.
title: Sharp fourth-cumulant isotropy under orientation-only resetting of an anisotropic Brownian particle
